entries.title: cmux-rd 0.2.9
entries.note: cmux-rd 0.2.9 for x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu (glibc 2.31 or later), built from d601762 with features openh264,link. The archive holds bin/cmux-rd, LICENSE (GPL-3.0-or-later) and THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md. It contains no H.264 codec: run cmux-rd openh264-install on the machine to download Cisco's OpenH264 from Cisco (pinned SHA-256).
